question: Which of the following Fundamental Rights is mentioned under Articles 32 to 35 of the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Right to Constitutional Remedies.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points:__

__
 
• In India, a person has the **legal right **to **file **a **petition **with the Supreme **Court **to have their **fundamental rights **upheld.
 
• For the Supreme Court and the High Court, respectively, this right is protected by **Articles 32 and 226.**
 
• The** right to constitutional remedies** is what it is called.
 
• **The Supreme Court **and **high courts** both have the **authority **to enshrine the fundamental rights under this provision.
 
• Additionally, **local courts **have the authority to **grant rights extensions.**
 
• However, there is one activity covered by the military law—**the court-martial**—that is immune from this privilege.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**
